notes.title: Ver.1.3.8 .3 update
notes.notes:
The entire screen presentation has been changed (Polaroid-style white frame has been added etc).

Changed the behavior of the “Thunder” attack skill.
Old: Thunder strikes directly above the enemy.
New: Lightning strikes forward and splits in two. The character can change direction until just before the attack.

Addition of two “? Merchant “.
Unusual weapons are sold.
(attack skills that were limited to special weapons can now be used)

"? Merchants" can be found in safe places in “dangerous villages” and “dangerous forts”.

Cursor movement speed on the UI (menus, etc.) has been increased.

Adjusted the L-stick so that the character cannot move without tilting the L-stick significantly.
etc...

notes.title: Ver.1.3.8 update
notes.notes:
Add outlines to the entire graphic.
Fine-tune the overall color.

Enhances attack skill "Arch". Additional attack occurs (with stun damage/looks like a leaf)
Fixed a bug where Silvia's 4th double edge could be used without meeting the usage conditions.
(If normal, use the 3rd twice to activate)

Slightly changed the 3D model display in conversation scenes.
etc...

If you want to revert back to the previous Ver 1.3.and1.3.231, please use Steam's beta feature.
